question: Should OpenClaw keep ambiguous no-reconciler outbound entries pending for later reconciliation rather than moving them to failed after this PR fixes the no-op pacing bug?
rationale: The code repair is narrow, but the behavior changes existing recovery semantics for ambiguous sends and affects whether operators see stuck pending rows or terminal failed rows.

options.title: Accept pending deferral after pacing fix
options.body: Merge after unavailable-reconciler rows bypass replay pacing and exact-head validation is green, preserving recoverability without blind replay.

options.title: Keep current terminal failure behavior
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's fail-closed behavior until a full delivery ledger/reconciliation design exists.

options.title: Fold into the broader ledger design
options.body: Hold this PR behind the broader delivery-state issue if maintainers want one schema/API decision before changing queue semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept pending deferral after pacing fix
recommendation.body: Merge after unavailable-reconciler rows bypass replay pacing and exact-head validation is green, preserving recoverability without blind replay.
